summary: MSC Income Fund, Inc. (NYSE: MSIF), a Houston-based business development company, filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, furnishing a press release under Items 8.01 and 9.01. The Board declared regular monthly cash dividends of $0.11 per share for January, February and March 2027, totaling $0.33 for the first quarter, plus a supplemental cash dividend of $0.03 per share payable March 23, 2027, funded from undistributed taxable income as of September 30, 2026. Distribution mechanics follow standard ex-dividend, record and payment dates; no M&A or structural event is present, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
